what: Mean absolute error in MPa on eight different 80/20 splits by mix over all 1,005 lab results. Every model was trained and scored on the same eight splits.

network_ensemble.model: five networks averaged; 18 inputs (the nine plus ln(age) and eight ratios), hidden layers 64 and 32, Huber loss, weight decay 0.003, 300 passes

single_network.model: the network the page trains: 10 inputs, hidden layers 64 and 32, squared-error loss, weight decay 0.001, 300 passes

ensemble_vs_trees.how: paired differences (ensemble minus trees) over the eight splits; t interval with 7 degrees of freedom

how_the_ensemble_was_chosen: By three-fold cross-validation on the 786 training rows only (whole mixes kept together): ensemble 4.48 MPa, trees 4.75 MPa on the same folds. It was then scored once on the page's held-out mixes: 3.92 MPa, against 3.29 MPa for the trees.
reading: A tie. The ensemble's average is 0.085 MPa (2%) lower than the trees', with a 95% confidence interval of -0.48 to +0.31 MPa, which includes zero. It wins four splits, loses three and ties one. On the page's own held-out split the trees are ahead.
